articles.title: It might be too late for bitcoin’s quantum migration, Project Eleven report argues
articles.snippet: Quantum computing does not only pose a risk to up to $3 trillion in digital assets, it also threatens the security of banking systems, military communications, digital identities and more, Project Eleven’s report warns.

articles.title: Bitcoin profit-taking may 'accelerate' as price hits 3-month high: Analyst
articles.snippet: Despite the short-term price recovery, Bitcoin remains in a bear market, according to CryptoQuant analyst Julio Moreno.

articles.title: Crypto Firms Race to 'Quantum-Proof' Wallets Before Bitcoin, Ethereum Networks Catch Up
articles.snippet: Crypto companies are upgrading wallets to counter the coming quantum computing threat, but gaps remain.

articles.title: Zcash Targeting Post-Quantum Crypto Milestone by 2027
articles.snippet: The privacy-focused cryptocurrency plans to launch a quantum-recoverable wallet within a month as it outlines its roadmap.
